common.disclaimer: AIControl supports governance and documentation; it is not legal advice. Classification results are indicative and must be reviewed by a responsible person.

role.title: Your role
role.intro: The AI Act sets different obligations for the party that builds a system and the party that uses it. Most companies only use systems.

prohibited.title: Prohibited practices
prohibited.intro: These uses have been banned in the EU since 2 February 2025. One yes means use has to stop.

highRisk.title: High-risk areas
highRisk.intro: Systems used in these areas are high-risk and come with extra obligations.

exception.title: Exception check
exception.intro: A system in a high-risk area is not high-risk when it only does supporting work and does not profile people.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.intro: For these systems people must be told that they deal with AI or with AI-generated content.

check.title: Check your answers
check.intro: Check your answers before you save the assessment. Use Change to correct an answer.

policy.title: AI policy
policy.none: No policy has been published yet.
policy.notAcknowledged: Version {version} is the current policy. You have not acknowledged it yet: read it and confirm below.
policy.acknowledgedOn: Version {version} is the current policy. You acknowledged the policy on {date}.
policy.wizardIntro: Answer eight questions. AIControl then writes a draft that you can edit before you publish it.
policy.editIntro: This is the draft. Edit the text where needed, then publish it.
policy.publishNote: A published version can no longer be changed. Everyone is asked to acknowledge the new version.

q.approvedToolsHint: From the AI register: systems with status approved or in use.
q.noTools: The register has no approved systems yet.
q.publicTools: May employees use free public AI tools?
q.forbiddenData: Which data may never be entered into AI tools?
q.humanReview: Is human review required before AI output is sent externally?
q.approverHint: A role or a name, for example: the IT manager.
q.labelling: How must AI-generated content be labelled?
q.labellingDefault: Content that is largely made by AI and shared outside the organization carries the note "Made with the help of AI".
q.incidentContact: Where do employees report incidents or doubts?
q.incidentContactHint: For example an email address or a person.
q.reviewMonths: How often is the policy reviewed?

reports.exportIntro: Everything in the database, except passwords. JSON holds all tables in one file; CSV is one file per table. Every export is recorded in the audit log.
